docstring: Let $Q_n$ be the $n$-dimensional hypercube graph (so that $Q_n$ has $2^n$ vertices and $n2^{n-1}$ edges). Is it true that every subgraph of $Q_n$ with $$\geq \left(\frac{1}{2}+o(1)\right)n2^{n-1}$$ many edges contains a $C_4$?
references: [BHLL14] Balogh, József and Hu, Ping and Lidický, Bernard and Liu, Hong, *Upper bounds on the size of 4- and 6-cycle-free subgraphs of the hypercube*. European J. Combin. (2014), 75-85.
[BHN95] Brass, Peter and Harborth, Heiko and Nienborg, Hauke, *On the maximum number of edges in a {$C_4$}-free subgraph of {$Q_n$}*. J. Graph Theory (1995), 17--23.
[Ba12b] R. Baber, *Turán densities of hypercubes*. arXiv:1201.3587 (2012).
[Er91] Erdős, P., *Problems and results in combinatorial analysis and combinatorial number theory*. Graph theory, combinatorics, and applications, Vol. 1 (Kalamazoo, MI, 1988) (1991), 397-406.
type_pretty:
∀ (ε : ℝ),
  0 < ε →
    ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
      ∀ H ≤ SimpleGraph.hypercube n,
        (1 / 2 + ε) * ↑n * 2 ^ (n - 1) ≤ ↑H.edgeSet.ncard → (SimpleGraph.cycleGraph 4).IsContained H
